turns.originalText: Why injection doesn't work: Module isolation - Each module is a separate import. Inference can't reach into code-assistant's scope to add methods. Cross-context calls - Business module might be in extension-page, inference in service-worker. Direct method calls won't route correctly. Runtime registration pattern - Actions are registered as `module.action` pairs, not injected functions. What you CAN do: Create a helper in the business module: This gives you clean call syntax while preserving the architecture. Full Plan Review: ✅ Use cases defined in module manifests ✅ Inference discovers all use cases at init ✅ Calls via `runtime.call('inference.useCase', {id, inputs})` ✅ Inference assembles query from template + inputs ✅ Executions saved to IndexedDB with use case reference ✅ Validation runs (blocking or async) ✅ Training module queries executions for optimization Missing anything?
